Q6097.reason: Most states abolish the fee tail or convert it to fee simple, so the cousin holds fee simple and the grantor has nothing left to convey to the niece.

Q5137.reason: The doctor personally examined the x-rays, so an opinion resting on facts not in evidence is not the problem; testimony about what the x-rays show is an attempt to prove their contents without producing them, which the best evidence rule bars.

Q5526.reason: Under modern statutes, entering a building through a window with intent to commit theft is burglary, while the other options lack an entry or a felonious intent at the time of entry.
